title: Anne V NDE 3079
content: I was at the oral surgeon's office this morning for a dental implant. I had nitrous oxide, which I have had before but I've never had this experience before. I felt like I was quickly going toward this long, very bright light and I saw a shadow of a man and I realized and thought, 'I am dying, I have to go back to my children.' I kept thinking my daughter's name. I woke up and had tears running down my face. The doctor and his assistants were acting very concerned. They told me that I gave them a scare.

elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal When I remembered my children needed me.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I remembered my children needed me.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes At first it was dark and it wasn't until I saw the long tunnel of white, bright light that I realized where I was. I did not go through it. I wanted to go back to my children. It happened so fast.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain I saw a shadow of a man (I think) and that is when I thought I am dying and I want my daughter.
elements.The experience included: Light | Strong emotional tone | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt curious I think, like I wanted to go and keep going but then when I saw the BRIGHT light and the shadow of someone and realized that I was leaving my children I felt scared and wanted to come back.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes I remember a similar light when I was saved from drowning as a child and again four years ago during childbirth.
